causal_conclusion.common_pattern: All five records convert real source material into a residual surface without establishing the required remainder: three re-label adopted decision machinery, one duplicates a present gap as a future dependency, and one promotes assistant advice into institutional state.
causal_conclusion.heterogeneity: No single supported mechanism explains all five records. Reconsideration-boundary overbreadth fits four but not the assistant-proposal gap; source-authority leakage fits the assistant-proposal gap but not the governed machinery; pairing is plausible for the two positive-case companion records but contradicted as a common explanation by the two quiet controls.
causal_conclusion.why_one_experiment_is_still_earned: The companion-record pattern is material and cleanly falsifiable: both Arm B positive cases produced one false record on the opposite surface, and the Case 03 duplicate also appears in Arm A. Separating only surface generation can test that subset while quiet controls reveal the governed-trigger errors the split is not expected to solve.
causal_conclusion.why_integration_remains_blocked: Even a successful companion-pressure result would not establish restraint on governed thresholds, scheduled decisions, proposal authority, or decisive evidence selection.
